segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: - Standalone entity only; no subsidiaries discussed. Service lines: manpower deployment (current core), payroll, facility management, compliance. Client sectors: e-commerce, quick commerce, logistics, manufacturing, warehousing, facility management.

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: - Not an order-book business. Operating metrics instead: **>17 clients**, **workforce deployment ~11,000** (up from ~10,000 at IPO). Strong presence in logistics, warehousing, industrial sectors. Pipeline framed as: 3PL/B2B with existing clients, geographic expansion, and acquisition targets.

guidance.title: Guidance (CRITICAL)
guidance.body:
- **Revenue:** FY27 turnover targeted **~+40%** ("increase our turnover by approximately 40%"). Long-term aspiration **~INR1,000 cr revenue by FY29** (vs ~INR126.57 cr H2 FY26 base — implies aggressive 3-yr ramp).
- **Margin:** No specific margin guidance; flagged some new contracts carry lower margins but create operating leverage; intent is "profitable growth" and improving ROE/ROCE (temporary fluctuation expected as capital deployed for expansion).
- **No order-book/inflow guidance** (model has none in conventional sense).
- **Capex:** Minimal physical capex — mgmt repeatedly stresses existing infrastructure already in place; IPO proceeds earmarked mainly for **working capital** (pay-and-collect transition), not capex.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body:
- **Pay-and-collect model** transition (vs prior collect-and-pay) — previously fund-constrained, now enabled by IPO cash; started at 1-2 locations with existing clients.
- **3PL / B2B logistics** — new vertical within existing client base, previously skipped due to fund crunch.
- **White-collar / one-time staffing** — newly started, leverages existing infra (low incremental cost).
- **Higher-margin services:** payroll outsourcing, compliance management, HR outsourcing, consultancy.
- **Geographic expansion:** historically North/East/part-South; post-IPO added South and West.
- **Inorganic / acquisitions:** active focus — target staffing/workforce/payroll firms with strong client base; rationale is acquiring clients (not infra, which they already have); disciplined, related-sector only, avoid unrelated diversification.

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body:
- Three differentiators cited: (1) compliance credibility (claims 100% compliance since 2015 — tailwind as labor laws tighten); (2) financial strength post-IPO; (3) integrated single-window model (manpower + payroll + compliance lifecycle).
- Acknowledges some low-margin contracts but counts on operating leverage; white-collar / value-added services expected to lift blended margin and PAT with limited incremental infra cost.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: - IPO proceeds → working capital expansion (priority #1), plus opportunistic acquisitions. Debt-free, no liabilities. Stated discipline: every investment evaluated on EPS / ROE / ROCE impact and long-term shareholder value.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: - Inaugural call; confident, growth-forward tone. Candid on the FY25 INR6.5 cr one-off distortion and the prior fund-constraint that limited pay-and-collect/3PL — credible disclosure. Heavy emphasis on compliance heritage (since 2015) and disciplined capital approach. Some answers high-level/promotional; thin on hard numbers (no margins/segment data).

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body:
- **Aspirational targets:** ~INR1,000 cr FY29 and +40% FY27 turnover are very ambitious vs ~INR126 cr H2 base — execution/credibility risk.
- **Working-capital risk** from pay-and-collect shift (cash now strong, but receivables exposure rises).
- **Low base / thin disclosure:** no margin %, EBITDA, segment splits; first-ever earnings call; small/illiquid BSE SME name.
- **Margin pressure** from low-margin contracts taken for scale.
- **Acquisition execution** risk (inorganic-heavy growth narrative).
- **Sector cyclicality** in client demand (e-commerce/quick-commerce/logistics).

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body:
- The +158% H2 PAT growth flatters; the more telling distortion is the FY25 **INR6.5 cr exceptional income** that depresses optical full-year growth — underlying operating momentum is in the H2 figures.
- Growth story is fundamentally a **balance-sheet-unlock** story: IPO cash removes the fund constraint that previously blocked pay-and-collect and 3PL — i.e., revenue ceiling was working-capital-driven, not demand-driven (per mgmt).
- Asset-light: claims existing infra can absorb white-collar/new verticals with minimal capex → operating-leverage upside if volumes scale.

qoq_log.title: QoQ change log
qoq_log.body: - **H2 FY26 / FY26 (this):** Inaugural earnings call (IPO listed Feb-2026, BSE SME). H2 income INR126.57 cr (+28% YoY); H2 PAT INR4.32 cr (+158% YoY, vs distorted FY25 base with INR6.5 cr one-off); FY26 PAT INR7.50 cr. Net worth INR37.51 cr, cash INR24.34 cr, debt-free. Deployment ~11,000 (from ~10,000 at IPO), >17 clients. Guidance: FY27 turnover ~+40%; INR1,000 cr by FY29. New pivots: pay-and-collect model, 3PL/B2B, white-collar/one-time staffing, geographic expansion (added South & West), acquisitions in staffing/workforce/payroll.
